how_expected_was_computed: By hand from docs/metrics.md. Graded = 4 (infra row K3 excluded). Successes 3 -> pass_rate 3/4. Seed rates: s11 = 1/2, s22 = 2/2; population variance = ((0.5-0.75)^2 + (1-0.75)^2)/2 = 0.0625. pass_5: K1 passes on both seeds, K2 does not -> 1/2. Cost over graded trials = 10+10+20+20 = 60 -> per success 60/3 = 20. Steps [2,4,6,8]: mean 5, p95 index ceil(0.95*4)-1 = 3 -> 8.
interpretation_choices: Cost: docs/metrics.md says 'tong cost mo phong cua moi trial, ke ca trial fail'. We read an infra trial as not graded, so its cost (5) is left out: 60, not 65. Reading 'moi trial' literally gives 65 and 65/3 = 21.67.
pass_5 denominator: K3 appears only as an infra trial. We leave it out of the claims, so 1/2, not 1/3.
Both choices follow the README relation 'infra trials are not decisions of the shape'. grader_c's cost and pass_5 entries in this oracle depend on these choices; its pass_rate entry does not.
